parsed.post: Discarding the increase in DEPTH to 6 as it caused val_bpb to rise (1.0116 -> 1.0647). The model might be overfitting or the optimizer/LR requires recalibration for the higher capacity. Reverting to DEPTH=4. Next: testing a higher learning rate (0.08) on the DEPTH=4 baseline to see if we can optimize faster.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH 4 and increasing learning rate to 0.08 to see if faster optimization improves val_bpb.
